stem.text: A block slides along a horizontal frictionless surface towards the spring, as shown.

stem.text: The block is brought to rest by the spring. When the spring reaches a compression of $4.0\,\text{cm}$, all of the kinetic energy of the block is transferred to the elastic potential energy of the spring.
